parameters.content:
## Intake Form
intake.html submissions:
1. AUTO-CREATE the client portal (clients upsert by slug +
   login invitation for the submitter email) — appears in the
   admin panel immediately. Nothing is sent to the client.
2. Email the team the full submission (voice note attached
   when recorded).

To deliver the portal to the client: email
ai@think-technologies.com 'send portal <company>' —
handled by 'Think Portal — Send Portal On Request'
(activate once hosting is live).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ slug: $json.slug, name: $json.company, domain: $json.domain || null, logo_url: $json.logo_url, logo_on_light: true }) }}

parameters.subject: =New intake [{{ $('Merge Client').item.json.industry || 'no industry' }}] — {{ $('Merge Client').item.json.company }} (voice note)
parameters.message:
={{ 'New client intake submission:

Name: ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.name + '
Company email: ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.email + '
Teammates to keep updated: ' + ($('Merge Client').item.json.teamEmails || '—') + '

Company: ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.company + '
Website: ' + ($('Merge Client').item.json.site || '—') + '
Social media: ' + ($('Merge Client').item.json.social || '—') + '
Industry: ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.industry + '

Main pain point (typed): ' + ($('Merge Client').item.json.painPoint || '— (voice note only)') + '

🎤 Voice note attached (' + $('Merge Client').item.json.audioSeconds + 's).' + '

PORTAL AUTO-CREATED (not sent to the client):
- It now appears in the admin panel under ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.company + '
- Portal link (live once hosting is enabled): https://saanchi-think.github.io/abracadabra/index.html?client=' + $('Merge Client').item.json.slug + '
- Next: link their Google Drive folder in the admin panel, then email ai@think-technologies.com with subject: send portal ' + $('Merge Client').item.json.company }}
